Disrupt their internal clockwork with the Resonance Tuner's harmonic pulse — but you don't have it yet. Instead, you must first shatter their central gear with a destabilized earth pulse.

It reflects geomantic pulses unless they are harmonized with the Resonance Tuner's frequency. Its body is made of mirrored brass plates that amplify and redirect magic — only a tuned pulse can penetrate its defenses.

It absorbs geomantic energy to heal itself. Each time you strike it with earth magic, it gains 15 HP. The only way to damage it is to use the Resonance Tuner's tuned pulse — but only if the Tuning Key is inserted and the frequency matches its internal resonance (which it changes every 5 seconds).
